channel.title: For Every Mom - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from For Every Mom (foreverymom.com)

item.title: Warn Your Kids About 'Tricky People' (not Just Strangers)
item.description: Instead of only telling your kids to stay away from strangers, also warn them of tricky people. Here are ways you can identify ticky people.

item.title: I Was Trying to Teach My Kids Generosity, But I Wasn't Ready for This
item.description: Friends, in our house, we mess up a lot. But, we got this right. Here's what happened when I attempted to teach kids generosity.

item.title: Why I Don't Do Elf on the Shelf (and I'm Not Even Kinda Sorry)
item.description: This mom has some pretty great reasons for keeping the elf off her shelf — including her own holiday to-do list. How do YOU feel about the Elf on the Shelf?

item.title: WATCH: Heroic UPS Driver Saves Boy Trapped Under Heavy Package
item.description: Four-year-old Max loves to bring delivered packages inside the house. But, one box was too much. Watch how this UPS driver saves boy trapped under a box.

item.title: WATCH: Texas Couple Makes 'Period Boards' Every Month For Teenage Daughters
item.description: A Texas couple took charcuterie boards a step further. They create "period boards" for their teenage daughters each month — including chocolate and tissues.

item.title: Dear Infertility, I Don't Hate You Anymore
item.description: Dear Infertility, I hated you. You steal dreams. You break hearts. You bring grief. You consume lives. You are the reason I couldn’t get pregnant on my own.

item.title: Why I Want My Strong-Willed Child to Continue Rolling Her Eyes
item.description: Being strong-willed can’t be silenced. My strong-willed child will speak her mind, will make sure she is understood, and will argue until she is heard.

item.title: Mark Wahlberg Listens to Old Voicemails To Keep the Memory of His Mom Alive
item.description: After the beloved matriarch of the Wahlberg family passed, Mark Wahlberg misses his mom. He listens to old voicemails to help keep her memory alive.

item.title: Dear God, Hear My Prayers To Be a Better Mom
item.description: I don’t want to be the “snappy mom," who yells at her children over the littlest things. But, it's hard. So, I recite these prayers to be a better mom.

item.title: What My Husband Told Me After a Double Mastectomy and Full Hysterectomy
item.description: Just four words that my husband consistently said became a lifeline for me as I recovered. I was beaten up and bruised after a double mastectomy.
